values: 陷入沉睡，处于无敌状态，召唤“星梦独角兽”桑尼强化友军召唤物并攻击敌人。
Aurora falls asleep and becomes invincible, summoning her unicorn Sonny to strengthen allied summons and attack enemies.

奥萝菈在身边召唤“星梦独角兽”桑尼并进入沉睡。桑尼继承自身140% + 20%的生命值和120% + 10%的其他基础属性，还会产生彩虹光环鼓舞友军，使所有友方召唤物提高50点急速且移动时的碰撞体积变小。本技能可以在受到控制期间释放。沉睡期间奥萝菈处于无敌状态，进行普通攻击时将具象化梦境中的物品，对敌人造成320% ATK伤害。在桑尼被击败时，奥萝菈会立刻惊醒，可以被攻击且无法使用终极技能以外的其他技能。
被动地，在战斗开始时奥萝菈就会处于沉睡状态并召唤桑尼，布阵最靠前的一名敌方英雄将被指定为“梦魇”，攻击力提升2%，急速降低40点，且桑尼会率领所有友方召唤物一同追击梦魇。

Aurora summons her unicorn Sonny to her side and drifts into a deep sleep. Sonny inherits 140% + 20% of Aurora's HP and 120% + 10% of her other basic stats, then creates a rainbow aura that inspires allies. All inspired allied summons gain 50 Haste, and their movement becomes smoother, letting them move past enemies and obstacles more easily. This skill can be cast even when Aurora is under control effects.
While asleep, Aurora stays invincible. For normal attacks, she conjures objects from her dreams and hurls them at enemies to deal 320% ATK damage. If Sonny gets defeated in battle, Aurora jolts awake. Once awake, she becomes vulnerable to enemy attacks and can't use any skills except her Ultimate.
Passive. When a battle starts, Aurora immediately falls asleep, and Sonny appears at her side. The frontmost enemy hero gets marked as the Nightmare. The mark reduces their Haste by 40, but increases their ATK by 2%. Sonny rallies all allied summons to focus their attacks on the Nightmare.
“星梦独角兽”桑尼继承自身生命值提升至160% + 20%。
“星梦独角兽”桑尼继承自身生命值提升至180% + 20%。
“星梦独角兽”桑尼继承自身生命值提升至200% + 20%。
“星梦独角兽”桑尼继承自身生命值提升至220% + 20%。
召唤仙兔，仙兔会攻击敌人并在达到存在时限后产生爆炸造成范围伤害。
Aurora summons a magical bunny that attacks enemies. The bunny detonates when its duration ends, dealing AoE damage.
本技能仅在奥萝菈沉睡期间可以使用。在自己身边召唤一只最多存在12秒的仙兔，继承自身100% + 10%的生命值和80% + 8%的其他基础属性。仙兔的普通攻击会对敌人造成100% ATK的伤害，并且当其达到存在时限时会跳向2格范围内最近的1名敌人并爆炸，对其周围1格的所有敌人造成340% + 40% ATK的伤害。

This skill can only be used while Aurora is asleep. Aurora summons a magical bunny beside her that lasts for up to 12s. The magical bunny inherits 100% + 10% of Aurora's HP and 80% + 8% of her other basic stats, and deals 100% ATK damage with its normal attack.
When the magical bunny's duration ends, it leaps at the nearest enemy within 2 tiles and detonates, dealing 340% + 40% ATK damage to all adjacent enemies.
仙兔爆炸对敌人造成的伤害提升至370% + 40% ATK。
Increases the bunny's detonation damage to 370% + 40% ATK.
仙兔爆炸对敌人造成的伤害提升至400% + 40% ATK。
Increases the bunny's detonation damage to 400% + 40% ATK.
仙兔爆炸对敌人造成的伤害提升至430% + 40% ATK。
Increases the bunny's detonation damage to 430% + 40% ATK.
若敌人在自身周围一段时间则会变成独角兽玩偶，持续一段时间。
If an enemy stays near Aurora long enough, they will be transformed into a unicorn plushie for a while.
奥萝菈沉睡期间，自身周围2格范围的现实将被梦境侵蚀。每当一名敌人在该范围内连续停留12秒，就会立即被变为独角兽玩偶，无法攻击和行动，持续1 + 0.125秒。同一名敌人在该区域连续停留的时间越久，其被变形的间隔就会越短，最低缩短至6秒。该效果无法对处于霸体状态的敌人生效。

While Aurora is dreaming, reality within 2 tiles around her slowly gets overtaken by her dream. If an enemy stays in that area for 12s, they will be transformed into a unicorn plushie, leaving them unable to move or attack for 1 + 0.125s.
The longer an enemy remains in the area, the faster each subsequent transformation triggers (minimum 6s). This effect does not apply to unaffected enemies.
变为独角兽玩偶的持续时间提升至1.5 + 0.125秒。
Extends the unicorn plushie transformation duration to 1.5 + 0.125s.
变为独角兽玩偶的持续时间提升至2 + 0.125秒。
Extends the unicorn plushie transformation duration to 2 + 0.125s.
变为独角兽玩偶的持续时间提升至2.5 + 0.125秒。
Extends the unicorn plushie transformation duration to 2.5 + 0.125s.
战斗中额外提升攻击力，每有一个来自不同友军的友方召唤物，额外提升攻击力。
Aurora increases her ATK. For every allied summon from a different ally on the battlefield, her ATK increases further.
战斗中，自身的攻击力提高10%。场上每有一个来自不同友军的友方召唤物，使自身攻击力额外提高1%，最多叠加5层。
Aurora increases her ATK by 10% during battle. For every allied summon from a different ally on the battlefield, her ATK increases further by 1%, up to 5 times.
战斗中，自身的攻击力提高13%。场上每有一个来自不同友军的友方召唤物，使自身攻击力额外提高1.5%，最多叠加5层。
Aurora increases her ATK by 13% during battle. For every allied summon from a different ally on the battlefield, her ATK increases further by 1.5%, up to 5 times.
战斗中，自身的攻击力提高16%。场上每有一个来自不同友军的友方召唤物，使自身攻击力额外提高2%，最多叠加5层。
Aurora increases her ATK by 16% during battle. For every allied summon from a different ally on the battlefield, her ATK increases further by 2%, up to 5 times.
奥萝菈沉睡期间，使友方召唤物获得强化，并额外使桑尼获得霸体。
While Aurora is asleep, allied summons are enhanced, and Sonny becomes unaffected.

奥萝菈沉睡期间，将会开启奇妙的梦幻剧场，使所有友方召唤物造成伤害提高4%，并分别赋予不同的演出身份：
近战召唤物：扮演“骑士”，受到伤害降低25%。
远程召唤物：扮演“公主”，普通攻击附带奥萝菈攻击力20%的额外伤害。
星梦独角兽·桑尼：扮演“王子”，同时拥有上述两种效果，并且获得霸体状态。

While asleep, Aurora opens her whimsical Dream Theater, boosting the damage of all allied summons by 4% and casting them in special roles.
Melee summons all take on the role of powerful Knights and take 25% less damage.
Ranged summons take on the role of graceful Princesses, allowing their normal attacks to deal extra damage equal to 20% of Aurora's ATK.
As for Sonny, Aurora's unicorn friend, he plays the role of the Prince. He gets both the Knight's and Princess' buffs and becomes unaffected.
使所有友方召唤物造成伤害提高8%。
Increase all allied summons' damage dealt by 8%.
使所有友方召唤物造成伤害提高12%。
Increase all allied summons' damage dealt by 12%.
友方召唤物对抗“梦魇”时，造成的伤害的50%将无视敌人所有的护甲和魔抗。
When allied summons deal damage to the enemy marked as Nightmare, 50% of the damage dealt ignores all enemy Phys & Magic DEF.
奥萝菈沉睡期间，若能量高于一定值，额外提升“梦现之蚀”的影响范围。
If Aurora's Energy is above a certain threshold while she is asleep, the range of Plushification increases.
奥萝菈沉睡期间，若自身能量值高于500点，则还会进入更加深度的睡眠，在此期间技能“梦现之蚀”的影响范围扩大至3格。
If Aurora's Energy is above 500 while she's asleep, she enters a deeper sleep, expanding the range of Plushification to a 3-tile radius.
